verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own docs describe a native capability matching the story: you describe what should happen with your files and an AI model carries it out. That is first-party natural-language task delegation, but the evidence is a single one-line mention with no detail on scope, interface or reliability. The MCP integration (docs-20) serves external AI clients rather than providing a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: details on where the assistant lives (web UI vs. API task), which operations it can chain or decide on its own, its limitations or controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
